Fuzz helpers for serializing and executing runtime transactions.

# Purpose
This header file declares the public interface for a transaction fuzzing harness used in runtime tests. It includes the required type definitions and wraps the declarations in include guards to prevent multiple inclusion. The function [`fd_runtime_fuzz_serialize_txn`](<#fd_runtime_fuzz_serialize_txn>) converts a Protobuf `SanitizedTransaction` into a raw transaction buffer and reports the number of bytes used, while enforcing the `FD_TXN_MTU` size limit. The function [`fd_runtime_fuzz_txn_ctx_exec`](<#fd_runtime_fuzz_txn_ctx_exec>) takes a parsed transaction descriptor, executes it against the runtime, and returns the transaction context while writing the execution result through `exec_res`.
